decision: **`plan/` branches merge themselves on green CI, like `brief/`; `meta/` stays the owner's.** The core's side of napoleon D62, which an agent working there can now act on here too. Liam's words: "I also don't need to be approving plan prs, they can be automatic". Accepted meanwhile: a `plan/` branch can change docs, this file included, with no human review, on green CI alone; a "proposed" line on one is accepted by its merge. Owner: `docs/REVIEW.md`.
